event_name: Date 05 September 2020 Time 17:40 2020 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 3 - 6 September 2020 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 29 & 30) and heard from the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine
fact: Incident between cars 31, 7 and 6 between turns 10 and 11.
offence: Alleged Breach of Articles 27.4 and 31.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the drivers and team representatives of Car 31 (Esteban Ocon) and Car 7 (Kimi Raikkonen). Having reviewed multiple angles of video evidence, telemetry and GPS data, the stewards concluded that what appeared to be erratic movement of cars was due to a combination of circumstances which they, and the two drivers present, agreed was probably unavoidable and was not dangerous. Car 44 was leading a line of cars on an out lap – in order, cars 6, 31 and 7, plus others. On the approach to Turn 11, car 6 slowed (ref telemetry) in order to achieve a reasonable gap to car 44 in front. This caused car 31 to have to take avoiding action by moving to the left, which caused car 7 to have to brake and move.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 31 T11 Incident
